description: This file implements a base class for an ODBC database driver and a record set class for handling database query results within the ADOdb PHP library. It provides methods for connecting to an ODBC data source, executing queries, managing transactions, metadata retrieval, and handling BLOB data, tailored for ODBC interactions.

classes.name: ADODB_odbc
classes.description: Implements the ODBC driver for the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library, handling database connections, queries, transactions, and metadata operations.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_odbc
classes.description: Represents a record set for ODBC query results, providing methods to fetch, navigate, and manage result data.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the ODBC data source using provided DSN, username, and password.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the ODBC data source.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the connected server.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence (auto-incrementing table) in the database.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Drops the specified sequence table.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID using a sequence table.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message encountered during database operations.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code encountered during database operations.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary keys for a specified table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables from the database.

methods.name: ODBCTypes
methods.description: Maps database-specific data type codes to generic types.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution, optionally with parameter binding.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query or statement, with optional parameter binding.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field with provided data.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.
